name: KY-03

Morgan McGarvey is an incumbent with a large financial advantage, over $1.8 million on hand

model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to McGarvey: a Democratic-leaning Louisville-area district, incumbency, and a fundraising edge of more than $1.6 million raised against a challenger with no reported finances. Markets agree, pricing the race as near-safe for Democrats, so the forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based margin of about 21 points.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a much closer race, or a surge of outside spending against McGarvey, would be the main signal to revisit this rating.

overview:
Morgan McGarvey, the Democratic incumbent in Kentucky's 3rd District, seeks another term in a seat the party holds comfortably. The district leans Democratic by about 10 points, and the favorable national environment adds to that edge. McGarvey has raised over $1.6 million and holds $1.8 million on hand, while Republican Maria Rodriquez reports no fundraising figures.

No public general-election polls or expert race ratings are available for this contest, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, money, and prediction markets, which price McGarvey at roughly 97 percent. The race remains Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of direct polling rather than any specific sign of vulnerability.
